text.zh: 角球混战，球飞向你和门将之间，裁判视线被挡住了……
text.en: A corner scramble; the ball floats between you and the keeper, the ref unsighted…

label.zh: 用手把球拍进，赛后说『这是上帝之手』
label.en: Punch it in, then call it 'the Hand of God'

note.zh: 用手把球打进、却假装是头球破门 —— 致敬马拉多纳 1986 年的「上帝之手」
note.en: Punch it in but claim it was a header — Maradona's 1986 'Hand of God'

background.zh: 同一场比赛，马拉多纳用手把球打进却被判有效，赛后称「这是上帝之手」，成为足球史最著名的争议进球。
background.en: In that same match, Maradona punched the ball in — it stood — and called it 'the Hand of God', football's most famous controversial goal.

label.zh: 老实承认手球，绅士风度
label.en: Own up to the handball — pure sportsmanship

label.zh: 我用头，干干净净顶进去
label.en: Use your head — clean as you like

label.zh: 情急之下，咬了对方后卫一口

note.zh: 急眼了咬对手一口 —— 致敬苏亚雷斯（生涯真的咬过三次）
note.en: Losing it and biting an opponent — homage to Suárez (who really did it three times)

background.zh: 苏亚雷斯职业生涯曾三次在场上咬对手（2010、2013、2014），天才与争议并存。
background.en: Suárez bit opponents three times on the pitch (2010, 2013, 2014) — genius and controversy in one.
